# External operations

The commands `mt help` lists under External operations. Tools are known as external operations (extops) in Maitento, which is why these commands start with `extop-`. More in [Tools](../../../concepts/tools.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`extop-delete`](#extop-delete) | Delete a tool (external operation) by name, without asking for `--confirm` (refused while an agent, interaction, app or code pipeline uses it) |
| [`extop-get`](#extop-get) | Show a tool (external operation) by name: its type, latest version, whether it needs approval, and its id |
| [`extop-list`](#extop-list) | List the tools (external operations) in a namespace (every namespace when none is set) |
| [`extop-version-disable`](#extop-version-disable) | Disable one version of a tool so it is never used again (anything pinned to it fails until you re-enable it or redeploy) |
| [`extop-version-enable`](#extop-version-enable) | Re-enable a disabled version of a tool |

## extop-delete

Delete a tool (external operation) by name, without asking for `--confirm` (refused while an agent, interaction, app or code pipeline uses it).

```text
mt extop-delete <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the tool to delete |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## extop-get

Show a tool (external operation) by name: its type, latest version, whether it needs approval, and its id.

```text
mt extop-get <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the tool to show |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## extop-list

List the tools (external operations) in a namespace (every namespace when none is set).

```text
mt extop-list [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## extop-version-disable

Disable one version of a tool so it is never used again (anything pinned to it fails until you re-enable it or redeploy).

```text
mt extop-version-disable <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the tool |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--version, -v <number>` | whole number | yes |  | The version number to disable |

## extop-version-enable

Re-enable a disabled version of a tool.

```text
mt extop-version-enable <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the tool |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--version, -v <number>` | whole number | yes |  | The version number to re-enable |
